title: INNER JOIN
summary: INNER JOIN returns rows where the join condition matches in **both** tables — ideal for required relationships.
objectives: Explain INNER JOIN in practical web-development terms
Recognize how SQL connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.code:
-- MySQL
SELECT o.id, u.email
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';
